<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="כסלו_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518916086_theRebbe_759" batchId="meluket-_D7_9B_D7_A1_D7_9C_D7_95_meluket__BH_POST_1766518916086_theRebbe_759__p004">
  <section v="9">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section discusses the printing of the Alter Rebbe's maamar, its enduring nature for all generations, and its connection to the war against Amalek and the coming of Moshiach.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">8)</t>
    <t s="1">Now, the maamar beginning with the words "To understand what is said in Etz Chayim" of the Alter Rebbe,</t>
    <t s="2">was until now in concealment,</t>
    <t s="3">and through various causes and circumstances it emerged from constriction, etc., and is now in print.</t>
    <t s="4">And the words of the Tzemach Tzedek are known,</t>
    <t s="5">that something in print is for all generations.</t>
    <t s="6">And one can connect this with what is said,</t>
    <t s="7">"The war of Hashem against Amalek from generation to generation,"</t>
    <t s="8">concerning which there are several interpretations and levels:</t>
    <t s="9">the generation of Moshe and the generation of Shmuel,</t>
    <t s="10">the generation of Moshe and Shmuel and the generation of Moshiach,</t>
    <t s="11">for then there will be</t>
    <t s="12">(not only "you shall blot out"</t>
    <t s="13">but also)</t>
    <t s="14">"I will surely blot out," etc.</t>
    <t s="15">And this is that through the service of "May your wellsprings spread forth outward"</t>
    <t s="16">(in which each one is occupied,</t>
    <t s="17">and from now on will be occupied even more)</t>
    <t s="18">we will merit the coming of Moshiach our righteousness</t>
    <t s="19">speedily in our days, and in the near future.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
